samples.xml_description:
<module id="div_8bit">
    <description>A simplified radix-2 divider designed for 8-bit signed or unsigned integers. This module takes a dividend and a divisor as inputs and outputs a 16-bit result containing both the quotient and the remainder.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The clock signal for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst">The reset signal to initialize or reset the module.</input>
        <input id="sign">Indicates whether the operation is signed (1) or unsigned (0).</input>
        <input id="dividend" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input dividend for division.</input>
        <input id="divisor" width_description="[7:0]">The 8-bit input divisor for division.</input>
        <input id="opn_valid">A 1-bit signal indicating the presence of a valid operation request.</input>
        <input id="res_ready">A 1-bit signal indicating that the 16-bit output result has already been acknowledged.</input>
        <output id="res_valid">A 1-bit output signal indicating the result is valid and ready.</output>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">The 16-bit output containing the remainder in the upper 8 bits and the quotient in the lower 8 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
    // Your implementation goes here
    // You can use any combination of Verilog RTL, Comba XML, and/or SystemVerilog tasks
    // For example, you may implement this module entirely in Verilog RTL
    // Or you could break up the implementation across multiple modules
    // And use Comba XML and/or SystemVerilog tasks to connect them
    // It's completely up to you how you choose to implement this module
    
    // NOTE: DO NOT change the existing port definitions
    // You may add additional ports if needed
    
    
    // TODO: your implementation here
    
    endimplementation>
</module>
